system.description: Your status within the SpyNet gives you access to additional resources, and you know the best sources for Restricted or Rare items. With a successful DC 20 Gather Information check, you can purchase standard weapons, Equipment, and transport services at 50% of the going rate, or Rare and Restricted weapons, Equipment, and transport services at 75% of the going rate.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide
